For those that have been requesting international channels, we first want to get an idea of what our community looks like in terms of location and language. You may have noticed that the current international channels are read only. I have locked these channels until we have moderators for each channel. The last thing we need is false information being spread within the community that can't be monitored.

So, to learn a little more about our community and to search for international moderator candidates, I have put together a form for you to fill out. Please follow the link below so that we can learn more about where you are located and what languages you speak. If you have interest in a moderation role for your native language and it's channel, please let us know in the form! Even if you are not interested in a role, please fill the form out so that we can get an idea of where our community is from!

https://form.jotform.com/220074099536155

Thanks everyone!

As we come closer to our first NFT sale, I need to send you all a friendly reminder. When we make our official announcement about the sale, we all will likely start to see a flood of scam attempts. PLEASE be diligent, PLEASE think about what you are clicking. If you see anything that is not on an official channel, DO NOT CLICK. 

We will NEVER DM you about any sale of any kind.
We will NEVER run any sale unannounced outside our official channels. 
Always double check what you are buying on the secondary market and make sure it is our official NFT.
Only visit our social channels via our linktree address: https://linktr.ee/CornucopiasGame

Thanks everyone! We are excited about what is coming and you should be too! Be smart, stay safe!
